hint.en: Device: Default data source, suitable for most stations; includes 'Grid Availability' and daily data. Station: Provides less information, no 'Grid Availability' or daily data, but supports stations with multiple inverters and micro inverters.
What you pay per kWh bought from the grid, as shown on your bill. Used for 'Grid cost today' and 'Billing cycle cost' until you change it.
Shown next to the cost values, for example ₱, € or $.

The date your meter was last read, as YYYY-MM-DD. Billing cycle energy and cost count from the start of that day. You can enter it after the fact; change it whenever a new cycle starts. Leave empty to count from the first day the app has on record.

The first day of the next billing cycle, as YYYY-MM-DD (the day after the current billing period ends). On that day the app starts the new cycle by itself, fires 'Bill cycle ended' and clears this field. Also set by the Flow action 'Set the bill cycle date'.
The interval while station data updated in the cloud. Check your inverter logger settings! Default: 390
The interval while looking for updated station data after the Normal Polling Interval expired. Default: 30
Include this text when reporting a problem with a new inverter model.
